vson_p:
# RCC-8 topological relation (no viewer needed for non-directional facts).
# Demonstrates: SpatialFact with rcc only (cat externally connected to mat).

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle eye_level :focalLength 50mm :framing medium_shot)
   :viewedBy cam
   :depicts (cat / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Animal)
   :depicts (mat / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
               :class Furniture)
   :hasFact (sf / SpatialFact
               :figure cat
               :ground mat
               :rcc EC))
vson_t:
@prefix vso:   <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#> .
@prefix allen: <https://vson.dev/v1/allen#> .
@prefix rcc:   <https://vson.dev/v1/rcc8#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix :      <https://example.org/scenes/anonymous#> .

:scene a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Composition> .
:cam a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#CameraView> .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#angle> "eye_level" .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#focalLength> "50mm" .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#framing> "medium_shot" .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#framedBy> :cam .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#viewedBy> :cam .
:cat a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#PhysicalObject> .
:cat <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#individuation> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Generic> .
:cat <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#animacy> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Agentive> .
:cat <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#countability> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Count> .
:cat <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#class> :Animal .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#depicts> :cat .
:mat a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#PhysicalObject> .
:mat <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#individuation> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Generic> .
:mat <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#animacy> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Inert> .
:mat <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#countability> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Count> .
:mat <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#class> :Furniture .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#depicts> :mat .
:sf a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#SpatialFact> .
:sf <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#figure> :cat .
:sf <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#ground> :mat .
:sf <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#rcc> <https://vson.dev/v1/rcc8#EC> .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#hasFact> :sf .
